seo.title: Accessible Luxury Bathrooms in Sunningdale | Install My Bathroom
seo.description: Level-access showers and reinforced walls built for Sunningdale's larger plots, finished to a high-end standard. Fit-only installation from £3,500.

hero.intro: Sunningdale is best known for the golf courses that share its name and the large detached properties surrounding them — Victorian and Edwardian houses, inter-war family homes, and more recent executive-style builds, many on private or gated roads. Plot sizes here tend to be generous, which usually means more flexibility on bathroom layout than a terraced or semi-detached property allows — exactly the kind of flexibility an accessible luxury bathroom benefits from when the shower waste, doorway or wall structure all need to move.

sections.heading: The three structural changes behind the finish
sections.body: An accessible luxury bathroom looks like any other high-end bathroom once it's finished, but getting there means solving three problems that a standard refit doesn't have to. First, the shower floor has to sit level with the rest of the room, which means moving the waste point rather than simply dropping a tray into the existing position. Second, the doorway needs to be wide enough for comfortable movement, which can mean shifting a stud wall or changing the frame. Third, any wall near the shower, WC or bath that might carry a grab rail needs solid blocking built in before it's boarded over. We plan all three at survey stage, before any first-fix work starts.

sections.heading: Why Sunningdale's plots make these changes easier
sections.body: Moving a waste run three feet to accommodate a freestanding bath, as we're often asked to do in Sunningdale, is rarely constrained by neighbouring structure, because plot sizes here tend to be generous and the properties are detached or set well apart from each other. The same latitude applies directly to accessible luxury bathroom work: re-routing a waste point for a level-access shower, or widening a doorway, is usually a more open conversation here than it would be in a terraced or semi-detached property where party walls and tight internal layouts limit the options.

sections.heading: What we assess at the £125 survey
sections.body: We look at the fall available to the existing drain and how far it would need to move for a level threshold, the floor build-up and joist direction, which internal walls are structural versus stud, and where support reinforcement makes sense based on how the room will be used. On a generous Sunningdale plot, including those on the private and gated roads in the area, this often means we can offer more than one layout option rather than being locked into the existing footprint.

sections.heading: Installation from strip-out to snagging
sections.body: Work starts with a full strip-out, followed by the waste re-route, any doorway widening, and the wall reinforcement, all before first-fix plumbing and electrics. Tiling comes next, then the final fit of the sanitaryware, brassware and furniture you've sourced, finishing with snagging. As a fit-only service, we're not selling you products — we're building the accessible structure behind them and finishing the room to the same standard as any other bathroom we install in the area.

faqs.q: Does Sunningdale's housing stock make a level-access shower easier to fit?
faqs.a: Generally yes. The generous plots and detached properties common here mean less constraint from neighbouring structure when moving a waste run or widening a doorway, compared with a terraced or semi-detached house.

faqs.q: Will the finished bathroom look like a standard accessible bathroom?
faqs.a: No. Support rails and reinforced walls are built in behind the tiles and finished in your chosen metal tone, so the room reads as a high-end bathroom rather than a clinical adaptation.

faqs.q: What does an accessible luxury bathroom cost in Sunningdale?
faqs.a: Installations start from £3,500, fit-only. The exact figure depends on the extent of the waste re-route, doorway work and your chosen products, confirmed at the £125 survey.

faqs.q: Can you accommodate a gated or private road for access?
faqs.a: Yes, this is common across Sunningdale. We agree access and delivery logistics with you at survey stage so the programme runs smoothly once work starts.
